source: National Data & Analytics Platform (NDAP) - NITI Aayog / GoI

ndap_pm_kisan_disbursement.title: PM-KISAN Direct Benefit Transfer Portal
ndap_pm_kisan_disbursement.description: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi state and district level fund disbursements.

columns.state_name: VARCHAR - State/UT name (e.g., MAHARASHTRA, BIHAR, TAMIL NADU)
columns.farmer_beneficiaries: BIGINT - Number of farmer accounts credited
columns.amount_inr: DOUBLE - Total fund amount disbursed in Indian Rupees

ndap_crop_production_census.title: Annual Agricultural Crop Census
ndap_crop_production_census.description: District-wise crop acreage, production yield, and seasonal harvest volumes.

columns.crop_name: VARCHAR - Crop variety (e.g., RICE, WHEAT, COTTON, SUGARCANE, SOYBEAN)
columns.area_hectares: DOUBLE - Cultivated land area in hectares
columns.production_tonnes: DOUBLE - Crop production harvest in metric tonnes
columns.yield_kg_per_hectare: DOUBLE - Crop productivity yield in kg per hectare

ndap_mandi_commodity_prices.title: e-NAM Mandi Market Commodity Arrivals & Prices
ndap_mandi_commodity_prices.description: Daily and monthly wholesale agricultural commodity prices across regulated mandis.

columns.commodity: VARCHAR - Commodity name (e.g., ONION, TOMATO, POTATO, MUSTARD)
columns.arrival_quantity_tonnes: DOUBLE - Quantity of arrivals in metric tonnes
columns.min_price_inr: DOUBLE - Minimum modal price per quintal in INR
columns.max_price_inr: DOUBLE - Maximum modal price per quintal in INR
columns.modal_price_inr: DOUBLE - Prevailing modal trading price per quintal in INR

ndap_fertilizer_distribution.title: Integrated Fertilizer Management System (iFMS)
ndap_fertilizer_distribution.description: District-level fertilizer allocations, stock availability, and retail point sales.

columns.fertilizer_type: VARCHAR - Chemical fertilizer formulation (UREA, DAP, MOP, NPK)
columns.requirement_tonnes: DOUBLE - Seasonal requirement projection in tonnes
columns.availability_tonnes: DOUBLE - Stock dispatched to retail points in tonnes
columns.sales_tonnes: DOUBLE - Actual DBT farmer point-of-sale volume in tonnes

ndap_soil_health_records.title: Soil Health Card Scheme Database
ndap_soil_health_records.description: Micro and macro nutrient soil test profiles and Soil Health Cards issued.

columns.samples_tested: INTEGER - Number of laboratory soil core samples analyzed
columns.cards_issued: INTEGER - Soil Health Cards distributed to farmers
columns.nitrogen_status: VARCHAR - Soil Nitrogen fertility classification (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH)
columns.phosphorus_status: VARCHAR - Soil Phosphorus status (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH)
columns.organic_carbon_pct: FLOAT - Percentage organic carbon soil content

ndap_education_stats.title: UDISE+ School Education & Demographic Statistics
ndap_education_stats.description: Unified District Information System for Education Plus student and literacy indicators.

columns.female_literacy_rate: FLOAT - Percentage female adult literacy rate
columns.male_literacy_rate: FLOAT - Percentage male adult literacy rate
columns.pupil_teacher_ratio: FLOAT - Number of students per accredited teacher

ndap_school_infrastructure.title: National School Facility & Basic Amenities Survey
ndap_school_infrastructure.description: School facility compliance including electricity, drinking water, toilets, and digital labs.

columns.total_schools: INTEGER - Total operational government and aided schools
columns.schools_with_electricity: INTEGER - Schools with functional grid power
columns.schools_with_drinking_water: INTEGER - Schools with verified potable drinking water
columns.schools_with_girl_toilets: INTEGER - Schools with separate functional girls toilets
columns.schools_with_computer_labs: INTEGER - Schools equipped with functional ICT computers

ndap_higher_education_aishe.title: All India Survey on Higher Education (AISHE)
ndap_higher_education_aishe.description: Colleges, universities, faculty census, and Gross Enrollment Ratios (GER).

columns.university_count: INTEGER - Number of chartered central, state, and private universities
columns.college_count: INTEGER - Number of accredited degree colleges
columns.gross_enrollment_ratio_male: FLOAT - Higher education GER for males (18-23 years)
columns.gross_enrollment_ratio_female: FLOAT - Higher education GER for females (18-23 years)

ndap_midday_meal_scheme.title: PM POSHAN / Mid-Day Meal Nutrition Portal
ndap_midday_meal_scheme.description: Coverage of school meal nutrition, foodgrain quotas, and student beneficiaries.

columns.institutions_covered: INTEGER - Government primary and upper primary schools covered
columns.primary_students_benefited: INTEGER - Enrolled primary school children receiving hot meals
columns.upper_primary_students_benefited: INTEGER - Upper primary children receiving meals
columns.foodgrains_allocated_mt: DOUBLE - Foodgrain allocation in metric tonnes (Wheat/Rice)

ndap_vocational_skill_training.title: Skill India & PMKVY Vocational Database
ndap_vocational_skill_training.description: Short-term skilling, ITI certifications, and placement records.

columns.sector_skill_council: VARCHAR - Industry sector (Healthcare, Electronics, Agriculture, IT)
columns.enrolled_candidates: INTEGER - Trainees registered in accredited centers
columns.placed_candidates: INTEGER - Candidates verified placed in formal employment

ndap_nfhs5_health_indicators.title: National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5)
ndap_nfhs5_health_indicators.description: District maternal health, child nutrition, immunization, and lifestyle indicators.

columns.institutional_births_pct: FLOAT - Percentage of births delivered in health facilities
columns.fully_vaccinated_children_pct: FLOAT - Percentage children aged 12-23 months fully vaccinated
columns.stunted_children_pct: FLOAT - Percentage children under 5 years who are stunted (height-for-age)
columns.anaemic_women_pct: FLOAT - Percentage pregnant/non-pregnant women who are anaemic
columns.households_improved_sanitation_pct: FLOAT - Households using improved sanitation facility

ndap_rural_health_infrastructure.title: Rural Health Statistics (RHS Bulletin)
ndap_rural_health_infrastructure.description: Primary healthcare centers (PHC), community health centers (CHC), and specialist doctors.

columns.doctors_at_phc: INTEGER - Allopathic doctors in position at PHCs
columns.specialists_at_chc: INTEGER - Surgeons, OBGYN, Physicians, Pediatricians at CHCs

ndap_maternal_child_mortality.title: Sample Registration System (SRS) Vital Statistics
ndap_maternal_child_mortality.description: Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR), Infant Mortality Rate (IMR), and Under-5 Mortality.

columns.maternal_mortality_ratio_mmr: INTEGER - Maternal deaths per 100,000 live births
columns.infant_mortality_rate_imr: INTEGER - Infant deaths per 1,000 live births
columns.under_five_mortality_rate_u5mr: INTEGER - Under-five deaths per 1,000 live births
columns.birth_rate: FLOAT - Crude birth rate per 1,000 population

ndap_ayushman_bharat_pmjay.title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Health Protection Portal
ndap_ayushman_bharat_pmjay.description: Golden card issuances, hospital empanelment, and secondary/tertiary claim settlements.

columns.cards_issued: BIGINT - Ayushman Bharat beneficiaries registered with e-cards
columns.empanelled_hospitals: INTEGER - Active public and private empanelled hospitals
columns.claim_amount_settled_inr: DOUBLE - Value of approved insurance claims disbursed in INR

ndap_national_tuberculosis_portal.title: Ni-kshay National TB Elimination Portal
ndap_national_tuberculosis_portal.description: Tuberculosis notifications, treatment completion outcomes, and nutritional support (Nikshay Poshan).

columns.total_notified_patients: INTEGER - Total public and private sector TB cases notified
columns.treatment_success_rate_pct: FLOAT - Percentage successfully completing therapy regimen
columns.hiv_screened_pct: FLOAT - Percentage TB patients with known HIV status
columns.dbt_nutritional_amount_inr: DOUBLE - Nikshay Poshan Yojana direct cash assistance paid in INR

mgnrega_state_annual_employment.title: MGNREGA National Rural Employment Portal
mgnrega_state_annual_employment.description: Mahatma Gandhi NREGA person-days generated, households engaged, and wage expenditures.

columns.households_worked: BIGINT - Unique rural households provided wage work
columns.total_mandays_generated: BIGINT - Total person-days of employment generated
columns.women_mandays_pct: FLOAT - Percentage of person-days generated by women workers
columns.total_wage_expenditure_inr: DOUBLE - Total direct wage transfers to worker bank accounts

ndap_pmgsy_rural_roads.title: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)
ndap_pmgsy_rural_roads.description: All-weather road connectivity to eligible unconnected rural habitations.

columns.sanctioned_road_length_km: DOUBLE - Road construction sanctioned in kilometers
columns.completed_road_length_km: DOUBLE - All-weather road constructed in kilometers
columns.habitations_connected: INTEGER - Rural habitations newly linked to paved network
columns.total_expenditure_inr: DOUBLE - Total capital scheme expenditure disbursed

ndap_jal_jeevan_tap_water.title: Jal Jeevan Mission Har Ghar Jal Portal
ndap_jal_jeevan_tap_water.description: Rural household tap water connections (FHTC) and water quality surveillance.

columns.total_rural_households: INTEGER - Total verified rural households in district
columns.households_with_tap_connection: INTEGER - Households with functional tap connections
columns.villages_certified_har_ghar_jal: INTEGER - Gram Panchayats with 100% certified tap coverage

ndap_pmay_rural_housing.title: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
ndap_pmay_rural_housing.description: Pucca houses sanctioned, constructed, and subsidy installments credited to homeless beneficiaries.

columns.houses_sanctioned: INTEGER - Number of pucca dwelling units approved
columns.houses_completed: INTEGER - Fully constructed and geo-tagged houses completed
columns.funds_transferred_inr: DOUBLE - Direct housing subsidy assistance disbursed in INR

ndap_gram_panchayat_finance.title: e-GramSwaraj Local Body Finance & 15th FC Grants
ndap_gram_panchayat_finance.description: Fifteenth Finance Commission basic and tied grants allocated to Gram Panchayats.

columns.gram_panchayat_count: INTEGER - Number of rural local bodies reporting
columns.grant_allocated_inr: DOUBLE - Central Finance Commission allocation in INR
columns.grant_utilized_inr: DOUBLE - Audited development expenditure executed in INR
columns.sanitation_drinking_water_expenditure_in: DOUBLE - Tied expenditure on sanitation and water
